name: Guition JC2432W328C (2.8" capacitive, one USB-C)
description: Guition's 2.8" CYD in a clear case: 240x320 ST7789 with CST820 capacitive touch, backlight on GPIO 27, TF card, RGB LED, speaker and light sensor.
verify: From Guition's own pin table, factory sketches and TFT_eSPI User_Setup.h for this board (mirrored at github.com/maxpill/JC2432W328): ST7789 on SCK 14, MOSI 13, MISO 12, CS 15, DC 2, no reset line; BGR, inversion off; backlight GPIO 27; CST820 at 0x15 on SDA 33, SCL 32, reset 25, polled; TF card on 18/19/23 with CS 5; RGB LED on 4/16/17 lit low; speaker on GPIO 26; light sensor on GPIO 34. Not seen on the glass here - nobody has the board. If the picture is a negative, turn Invert on; if red and blue are swapped, set RGB; if touches land mirrored, set the touch axes on the Touch tab. Guition's own code runs the panel at 55 MHz and openHASP at 24 MHz; if the picture breaks up, lower the SPI speed on the Display tab. If the back is marked R, use the JC2432W328R preset.
